data.title: Kevin O'Leary Is Certain Ethereum Won't Be the 'Standard' Across Industry Sectors — The 'Shark' Says These Coins Could Gain Interest
data.description: Influential investor and media personality Kevin O’Leary expressed doubts on Sunday about Ethereum’s dominance in the cryptocurrency space, hinting at potential investments in chains like Solana and Avalanche.
